SELECT code, codeName FROM ( SELECT A.COCD AS code, A.CONM AS codeName FROM UI_CO A, UI_ADMIN_CO B WHERE A.COCD = B.COCD AND B.ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} UNION SELECT COCD, CONM FROM UI_CO WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM UI_ADMIN_CO WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} ) ) AS RS WHERE 1=1
AND ( code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') OR codeName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') )
ORDER BY codeName

SELECT COCD AS code, CONM AS codeName FROM UI_CO WHERE 1=1
AND ( COCD LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') OR CONM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') )
AND CONM = #{codeName}
ORDER BY codeName
SELECT A.COCD AS code, A.CONM AS codeName FROM UI_CO A, UI_ADMIN_CO B WHERE A.COCD = B.COCD AND B.ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} ORDER BY codeName

SELECT code, codeName FROM ( SELECT A.GENERALCD AS code, A.GENERALNM AS codeName FROM UI_GENERAL A, ( SELECT A.COCD, A.CONM FROM UI_CO A, UI_ADMIN_CO B WHERE A.COCD = B.COCD AND B.ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} UNION SELECT COCD, CONM FROM UI_CO WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM UI_ADMIN_CO WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} ) ) AS B WHERE A.COCD = B.COCD
AND FIND_IN_SET(A.COCD, REPLACE(#{coCd}, '|', ','))
) AS RS WHERE 1=1
AND ( code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') OR codeName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') )
ORDER BY codeName

SELECT A.code, A.codeName FROM ( SELECT A.COCD, A.BUSICD AS code, A.BUSINM AS codeName FROM UI_BUSI A, UI_ADMIN_BUSI B WHERE A.BUSICD = B.BUSICD AND B.ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} UNION SELECT COCD, BUSICD, BUSINM FROM UI_BUSI WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM UI_ADMIN_BUSI WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} ) ) AS A, ( SELECT A.COCD, A.CONM FROM UI_CO A, UI_ADMIN_CO B WHERE A.COCD = B.COCD AND B.ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} UNION SELECT COCD, CONM FROM UI_CO WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM UI_ADMIN_CO WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} ) ) AS B WHERE A.COCD = B.COCD
AND FIND_IN_SET(A.COCD, REPLACE(#{coCd}, '|', ','))
AND ( A.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') OR A.codeName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') )
ORDER BY A.codeName

SELECT BUSICD AS code, BUSINM AS codeName FROM UI_BUSI WHERE 1=1
AND ( BUSICD LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') OR BUSINM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') )
AND FIND_IN_SET(COCD, REPLACE(#{coCd}, '|', ','))
AND BUSINM = #{codeName}
ORDER BY codeName
SELECT A.BUSICD AS code, A.BUSINM AS codeName FROM UI_BUSI A, UI_ADMIN_BUSI B WHERE A.BUSICD = B.BUSICD AND B.ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} ORDER BY codeName

SELECT code, codeName FROM ( SELECT A.SERVICECD AS code, A.SERVICENM AS codeName, SORT FROM (SELECT LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 3) AS SERVICECD, CONCAT(SERVICENM_LV1, ' > ', SERVICENM_LV2) AS SERVICENM, A.SORT FROM UI_SERVICE A GROUP BY LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 3), SERVICENM, A.SORT) A, UI_ADMIN_SERVICE B WHERE A.SERVICECD = B.SERVICECD AND B.ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} UNION SELECT SERVICECD, SERVICENM, SORT FROM ( SELECT LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 3) AS SERVICECD, CONCAT(SERVICENM_LV1, ' > ', SERVICENM_LV2) AS SERVICENM, A.SORT FROM UI_SERVICE A GROUP BY LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 3), SERVICENM, A.SORT) AS R WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM UI_ADMIN_SERVICE WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} ) ) AS RS WHERE 1=1
AND ( code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') OR codeName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') )
GROUP BY code, codeName ORDER BY MAX(SORT)

SELECT code, codeName, useYn FROM ( SELECT LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 3) AS code, CONCAT(SERVICENM_LV1, ' > ', SERVICENM_LV2) AS codeName, A.SORT, MAX(A.USE_YN) AS useYn FROM UI_SERVICE A GROUP BY LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 3), codeName, A.SORT UNION SELECT LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 4) AS code, CONCAT(SERVICENM_LV1, ' > ', SERVICENM_LV2, ' > ', SERVICENM_LV3) AS codeName, A.SORT, MAX(A.USE_YN) AS useYn FROM UI_SERVICE A WHERE A.SERVICECD = 'EMMA' GROUP BY LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 4), codeName, A.SORT UNION SELECT CONCAT(LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 4),'X') AS code, CONCAT(SERVICENM_LV1, ' > ', SERVICENM_LV2, ' > ', SERVICENM_LV3, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM UI_SERVICE WHERE SERVICECD = 'EMMA' AND SERVICENM_LV3 REGEXP '[가-힣]') > 0 THEN ' 제외' ELSE ' except' END) AS codeName, A.SORT, MAX(A.USE_YN) AS useYn FROM UI_SERVICE A WHERE A.SERVICECD = 'EMMA' GROUP BY LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 5), codeName, A.SORT ) AS RS
WHERE ( code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') OR codeName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') )
GROUP BY code, codeName, useYn ORDER BY MAX(SORT)

SELECT LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 3) AS code, CONCAT(A.SERVICENM_LV1, ' > ', A.SERVICENM_LV2) AS codeName FROM UI_SERVICE A, UI_ADMIN_SERVICE B WHERE LEFT(A.SERVICECD, 3) = B.SERVICECD AND B.ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} UNION SELECT LEFT(C.SERVICECD, 4) AS code, CONCAT(C.SERVICENM_LV1, ' > ', C.SERVICENM_LV2, ' > ', C.SERVICENM_LV3) AS codeName FROM UI_SERVICE C, UI_ADMIN_SERVICE D WHERE LEFT(C.SERVICECD, 4) = D.SERVICECD AND C.SERVICECD = 'EMMA' AND D.ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} UNION SELECT LEFT(E.SERVICECD, 5) AS code, CONCAT(E.SERVICENM_LV1, ' > ', E.SERVICENM_LV2, ' > ', E.SERVICENM_LV3) AS codeName FROM UI_SERVICE E, UI_ADMIN_SERVICE F WHERE LEFT(E.SERVICECD, 5) = F.SERVICECD AND E.SERVICECD = 'EMMAX' AND F.ADMIN_ID = #{adminId}
